modules.name: session
modules.responsibility: Pinned snapshot session lifecycle, immutable dataset/variable/timestep binding, and session-level lifecycle governance.

modules.name: coordinates
modules.responsibility: Bidirectional conversion between geodetic (WGS84 lon/lat), non-uniform depth LUT (0.494m to 453.938m), normalized volume space [0,1]^3, local ENU, and brick-local sample coordinates.

modules.name: temporal
modules.responsibility: 7-day discrete time-scrubbing controller with automatic stale-generation epoch tagging and cancellation dispatch.

modules.name: planning
modules.responsibility: Frustum & ROI visibility culling, 3-level anisotropic horizontal LOD selection with hysteresis deadbands, and priority score computation for @quasar/client scheduler.

modules.name: residency
modules.responsibility: Resident brick ledger tracking CPU-decoded and GPU-resident page states, reference-passed memory accounting without double buffering.

modules.name: clipping
modules.responsibility: Physical depth range, geodetic bounding box, and arbitrary analytical clipping plane math in normalized volume coordinates.

modules.name: packet
modules.responsibility: Synthesis of backend-neutral RenderPacket containing texture buffer references, uniform structs, depth LUT arrays, transformation matrices, and scalar ranges.

modules.name: picking
modules.responsibility: Backend-neutral provisional pick ray casting with error bounding, delegating to TASK-05 authoritative exact query reconciliation.

transitions.action: Query catalog metadata from FastAPI service.
Pin active snapshot ID and anchor cryptographic hash.
Fetch volume render manifest and verify SHA-256.
Initialize depth LUT, bounding boxes, and coordinate transformers.
Evaluate initial camera ROI/LOD and dispatch brick stream requests.
All visible viewport bricks at target LOD loaded into residency.
Fine LOD pending; coarsened LOD rendered to maintain 60 FPS frame rate.
Fine LOD bricks arrived and uploaded to GPU.
Advance epoch, re-evaluate frustum, queue new visible bricks.
Capture QuasarErrorDetail, emit error event, retain last valid state.
Abort all inflight streams, evict caches, release GPU textures.
Nullify references and enter terminal state.

depth_lut_transformation.forward_mapping: Monotonic piece-wise linear interpolation between discrete depth levels z_k
depth_lut_transformation.inverse_mapping: Exact binary search across depth_lut_entries_m to resolve continuous depth from normalized w

memory_budget_coordination.strategy: Direct object reference passing of DecodedBrick.rawBuffer; zero intermediate array copies between client and renderer.
